messages:
Jess (People Ops): Hey — new hire Maria L. starts 2026-06-01 and will work remote to SF. She's doing an H-1B transfer; I-94 currently expires 2026-05-15. Need a quick checklist: benefits enrollment, I-9 timing, asset shipping, and travel clearance. Who owns what?
Sam (Recruiter): Offer signed. I can collect docs during our kickoff call and upload to the secure portal.
Alex (ENG): Quick Q — will Maria visit the office the first week? If not, we need laptop ship + VPN access + onboarding accounts.
Jess (People Ops): She prefers remote for the first month. Please approve laptop + monitor shipping. @Legal Team can you confirm whether a transfer receipt is sufficient for Day 1?
Legal Team: For a remote Day 1 we require the H-1B transfer receipt notice, passport copy, and completed I-9 docs on file. If the I-94 expires before approval, the transfer receipt date is what matters. We can confirm with our outside counsel if any additional memos are needed.
Mike (People Ops): I'll schedule benefits enrollment in week 1. Does she have an SSN yet? That affects payroll/bank setup. @Sam
Sam (Recruiter): She does not have an SSN yet — applied and waiting. She had an EAD previously but is moving to H-1B transfer now.
ImmigrationBot: Reminder: Upload H-1B transfer receipt, assign attorney, and confirm biometrics if requested. Checklist: https://intranet/redwood/immig/checklist
Jess (People Ops): Thanks all. @Alex please create an IT asset request: laptop + monitor + dongle to ship to Maria at 123 Remote Ave, San Francisco. Email: maria.l@example.com
Alex (ENG): Got it — I'll open an IT ticket and include VPN/Okta roles. ETA for shipping depends on stock, will update.
Sam (Recruiter): I'll collect passport + I-94 scans today and upload to the secure portal.
Jess (People Ops): :thumbsup: I'll follow up with benefits enrollment calendar invite and a one-pager for remote onboarding expectations. If Legal confirms anything else, tag this thread.
